pain_point: Customer support managers have no quick way to audit whether their team's responses match the intended brand voice tone — they read individual tickets manually and guess
target_user: Customer support team leads and QA managers at SaaS companies (50–500 employees)
visual_style: 1950s Hi-Fi Stereo Equipment — warm walnut veneer console aesthetic with brushed brass accents, analog VU meter readouts for each tone dimension, rotary knob controls. The deliberate pairing of mid-century audio equipment design with text sentiment analysis is the visual identity.
tech_stack: React + TypeScript + Vite, served via nginx in Docker

brainstorm_list.name: ToneCheck
brainstorm_list.pain: Support managers can't quickly audit whether team responses match brand voice — they read tickets manually and guess at consistency

brainstorm_list.name: FormDrill
